_howTo: Each player's portrait: the champion shown wherever their main would be, and the skins it fades between. Use the skin names from the League client (or "default"). Players not listed show their most played champion's default skin. Run npm run gen-data -- --offline after editing.
_framing: A skin can also be { "name": ..., "zoom": 1.7, "focus": [x, y] } to zoom in. focus is the point to zoom toward, in % across and down the splash at ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/img/champion/centered/<Champion>_<skin number>.jpg
